issues: The evolve ability condition is incorrectly encoded as {"type":"enteredFromCemetery"}, which is not an implemented condition. It should be encoded as an evolve ability that activates only if this follower was put onto the field from the cemetery; implement a condition such as {"type":"notEnteredFromHand"} or a more specific {"type":"enteredFromCemetery"} to support this text.
The card should not list "lastWords" in keywords; Last Words should be represented by the lastWords-timing ability only.

The continuous text "This card can only be played from hand" is missing. Add a passive ability preventing play from non-hand zones; this requires a new implemented passive restriction ability such as a play-source restriction.

The activated EX area ability's second clause is wrong: it uses grantActRestriction, but the source says the chosen follower "can't attack enemies" for the rest of the turn. Replace that with an attack restriction on the chosen target; this requires a new implemented effect for 'can't attack followers/enemies until end of turn'.

The aura is too broad and inaccurate: it grants Rush to trait "Dragon", but the source specifies your Dragon tokens. It should only affect Dragon token cards on your field, e.g. auraGrantKeyword with identity/filter support for the Dragon token; implement token-name/cardNo filtering for auraGrantKeyword if needed.

The activated ability incorrectly summons a Dragon token under the controller of this amulet after destroying any follower. The source says the destroyed follower's controller summons a Dragon token. Encode the summon for that follower's controller; this requires support for summoning to the selected target's controller.
The card should not list "lastWords" in keywords; Last Words should be represented by the lastWords-timing ability only.

The triggered ability timing is incorrectly encoded as "onExAreaEntry", which is not an implemented timing. It should be a trigger for "Whenever a card is put into your EX area"; implement a timing such as onExAreaEntry/onCardToExArea and use it here.

The trigger condition is too broad/unspecified in current encoding support. It should trigger specifically whenever a card is put into your EX area, not on unrelated events; implement explicit EX area entry event support.

The fanfare follow-up is missing the condition "If you put a card that costs 5 or more into your EX area". The current always/always encoding is incorrect. It should check the card moved by putDeckTopToExArea and only then let you choose to evolve this follower or return it to hand; implement a condition/result hook for the moved card's cost.

The auto-evolve option is incorrectly wrapped in autoEvolveIf with an always condition. It should simply evolve this follower as one branch of the conditional choice after a 5+ cost card is put into your EX area; implement a direct self-evolve effect if needed.

The return-to-hand option targets {"type":"self"}, but returnToHand expects a follower/card target selector that can legally reference this follower on the field. Encode the source card returning to its owner's hand with appropriate self-target support for returnToHand, or implement it if missing.
